name: Surya Pratama
role: Founder of Orenji Music School | Co-Founder of Arkas Ideas | Commissioner of PT Sumber Agung Fastener | Business Consultant at Kojo Project
bio: Surya Pratama is the founder and CEO of Orenji Music School, a music-education business. He is also co-founder of Arkas Ideas, commissioner of PT Sumber Agung Fastener, and a business consultant at Kojo Project, reflecting a career across education, creative work, and industry.

name: Cynthia Cecilia
bio: Cynthia Cecilia is the co-founder and managing director of Jobhun, an Indonesian career-development platform. She founded Jobhun in 2015 and led its transition into PT Jobhun Membangun Indonesia in 2020, with the platform providing training and career support.

name: Shinta Soebijandono
role: Government Relations for Millenial Job Center (MJC) Program
bio: Speaker at IdeaFest SUB 2026, Government Relations for Millenial Job Center (MJC) Program.

name: Yemima Chandra
bio: Yemima Chandra is the founder of Veloute Beauty Lounge and a permanent make-up artist. She has worked in PMU since 2012, bringing more than a decade of beauty-industry experience to her entrepreneurial practice.

name: Raisa Akwilla
role: Head of Marketing and Business Development at Transmarco Group
bio: Raisa Akwilla leads marketing and business development at Transmarco Group. Her work spans branding, retail strategy, and regional marketing leadership for the group of companies.

name: Edwin Tranggono
role: Creative Director of Middleform Design Studio
bio: Edwin Tranggono is the founder and creative director of Middleform Design Studio and a board member of the Indonesian Graphic Design Association (ADGI). A Surabaya-based graphic designer and comic artist, he also launched the independent Lineakomik label and created the titles Naraka, Sibiru, and Elang Hitam.

name: Bryan Valenza
role: Co-Founder of Beyondtopia, Comic Creator & Artist
bio: Bryan Valenza is a comic creator, author, and co-founder of Beyondtopia, an original storyworld rooted in Southeast Asian history and folklore. He is an exclusive color artist at Marvel Comics and previously worked as a colorist for DC Comics.

name: Stefani Gabriela
bio: Stefani Gabriela, known online as Mama Nick, is a content creator and family storyteller. Her relatable family-focused videos have built a major social presence, including more than one million TikTok followers and a YouTube channel centered on creating the family she wishes to have.

name: Edwin Nafarin
bio: Edwin Nafarin is a principal at Dpavilion Architects. His work includes Contertainer, a container-based public facility project comprising a polyclinic and library, and reflects his interest in accessible, people-oriented architecture.

name: Rendy Hendrawan
bio: Rendy Hendrawan founded Supratman Arsitektura in Surabaya in 2019. The studio has received architectural-media attention for adaptive projects such as Radjamie, which transformed a former pharmacy building into a characterful noodle restaurant.

name: Arief Budiono
bio: Arief Budiono is Chair of the Startup Ecosystem of Surabaya and East Java and serves as Vice Chair for Creative Industry at KADIN. An ITS and Universitas Surabaya alumnus, he has also worked as a BAPPEKO Surabaya expert and a Ministry of Communication and Informatics mentor for digital ventures.

name: Yazerlin Nadila Balqis
role: Founder of Sayurmoms, Ketua Umum Paguyuban Cak & Ning Surabaya
bio: Yazerlin Nadila Balqis is the founder of Sayurmoms, a Surabaya-based online grocery business, and Chair of Paguyuban Cak & Ning Surabaya. She represents a new generation of local entrepreneurs building digital businesses around everyday consumer needs.

name: Andrew Hartono
role: CEO of NAIL2000, GTS POWER GENSET, JCI EAST JAVA PRESIDENT 2025
bio: Andrew Hartono is CEO of NAIL2000, a role he has held since 2010, and CEO of GTS Power Genset since 2017. He also served as 2025 Local President of JCI East Java, pairing industrial-business leadership with youth civic leadership.

name: Ryan Wirasasmita
role: CEO of Buana, Founder of Timberlab
bio: Ryan Wirasasmita is CEO of PT Buana Triarta, an Indonesian hardwood manufacturer and construction-solutions company, a position he has held since 2010. He is also the founder of Timberlab Asia and terradeck, extending his work into timber innovation and sustainable material solutions.

name: Aristia Chen
bio: Aristia Chen is co-founder and chief marketing officer of Mazuta Group, a fast-growing Indonesian distributor of global consumer and lifestyle brands. She leads brand growth for a portfolio that includes Ecovacs, Tineco, Laifen, and Usmile, and has been recognized by Prestige Indonesia's 40 Under 40.

name: Evelyn Jiang
bio: Evelyn Jiang is an Indonesian Mandopop producer, singer, and songwriter. She is known for producing her own songs and has developed a prominent audience across streaming and social platforms as an Indonesian Chinese-language music artist.

name: Rosiana Ayu
role: Creative Marketing Director of REI Skin, Multi-Creative Specialist
bio: Rosiana Ayu is Creative Marketing Director at REI Skin and a multidisciplinary creative strategist. With more than 12 years of experience in branding, design, and marketing direction, she helps shape the Surabaya skincare company's creative identity.

name: Jocab Santosa
bio: Jocab Santosa is Creative Director at 8IDEA Studio. He is a visual storyteller and creative thinker whose work focuses on translating ideas into impactful visual narratives.

name: Mathina
bio: Mathina is the founder of Fablyme, a skincare brand centered on self-love and holistic wellness. As a neurodivergent founder, she has positioned the brand as an inclusive space for self-acceptance, well-being, and compassion.

name: Joefanca
bio: Joefanca is co-founder of Fablyme, an inclusive skincare and wellness brand. A neurodivergent founder, she advocates through the brand for self-growth, compassion, acceptance, and respect for individual journeys.

name: Chikology
bio: Chikology is a content creator and mental-health counselor who uses digital platforms to engage a large Indonesian audience. Her TikTok account has attracted hundreds of thousands of followers, giving her a notable presence in creator-led conversations around well-being.

name: Mizan Sulthon
bio: Mizan Tamimy Sulthon is CEO of Parahita Diagnostic Center, a healthcare diagnostics provider. He is also known as a healthcare marketing leader and serves as CEO of Kamila Printing & Packaging, bringing cross-sector operating experience to his work.

name: Charles Wonsono
bio: Charles Wonsono is Healthcare Business Director at Siloam Hospitals Group. He leads the group's non-hospital healthcare portfolio and has also held strategy and business-effectiveness leadership responsibilities within the organization.

name: Arumi Bachsin
bio: Arumi Bachsin is an Indonesian actress, model, and public figure. She became known through television dramas and films, with early screen credits including Azizah and Bestfriend? (2008), and remains a visible media personality.

name: Emil Elestianto Dardak
bio: Emil Elestianto Dardak is Vice Governor of East Java and previously served as Regent of Trenggalek from 2016 to 2019. A public-policy leader with business and academic credentials, he received the Philip Kotler Entrepreneur Award in 2017 and is a prominent voice on regional development and creative-economy issues.

name: Andre Astono
bio: Andre Astono is the founder of Goodfellows Barbershop, a Surabaya grooming brand. He is known for building the business around consistent service and a distinct brand identity.

name: A. Ditya Wardhana
bio: A. Ditya Wardhana is the co-founder and COO of Kopi Titik Koma, where he oversees operations for the Indonesian coffee business. He brings an industrial-organizational psychology background to the company and is a public voice on coffee entrepreneurship.

name: Samuel Lie
bio: Samuel Lie is the owner of Common Grounds Surabaya and is associated with the Common Grounds East Java operation. His professional background also includes KRUI Artisan Bakery, and he studied at Universitas Ciputra Surabaya.

name: Jimmy Carlos Simamora
bio: Jimmy Carlos Simamora is a Channel Manager at Huawei Indonesia, focused on strategic partnerships and channel ecosystem growth. He brings more than a decade of technology-sector experience across business development and product management, including prior roles at Samsung and Targus.

name: Guritno Wirandoko
role: Sustainability Manager of PT SUPARMA TBK
bio: Guritno Wirandoko is Sustainability Manager at PT Suparma Tbk, the Indonesian paper manufacturer he joined in 2009. His career at the company spans production and sustainability, and he represents its environmental work in industry forums on efficiency and carbon neutrality.

name: Dr. Agus Windharto. DEA.
bio: Dr. Agus Windharto, DEA, is an ITS academic and design-innovation practitioner affiliated with its Center for Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology. His work spans product design, including apparel, furniture, appliances and transportation, and his recorded intellectual-property work includes an urban luxury electric scooter.

name: Ario Bayu
role: Certified AI Consultant, Founder of Zero One and PrivGate.ai
bio: Speaker at IdeaFest SUB 2026, Certified AI Consultant and Founder of Zero One and PrivGate.ai.

name: Abibayu Gustri Kamadjaja
role: Creator & VP of Social Bread Enterprise
bio: Abibayu Gustri Kamadjaja is a content creator, entrepreneur and Vice President of Social Bread Enterprise. He leads work for corporate and brand social-media needs, including campaigns, KOL management and social-commerce activity, while maintaining a sizeable public creator presence.

name: Winona Araminta
bio: Winona Araminta is a Jakarta-based storyteller and content creator known online as @kamusnana. Her audience spans Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, where she publishes lifestyle and personal-storytelling content; she also works as a freelance strategist.

name: Enos Aditya Saputra
bio: Enos Aditya Saputra is the Creative Director of Beast Studio, a Surabaya-based creative agency and production house. An entrepreneur and brand strategist with more than 12 years of experience, he has also delivered digital-marketing training for SMEs in collaboration with Universitas Airlangga.

name: Timothy Rubino
bio: Timothy Rubino is the founder of KOKOMOBIL and an entrepreneur also associated with Quicklin. Based in Surabaya, he shares business, entrepreneurship and personal-development content across his public channels.

name: Ferry Siswadi SE
role: Director of Bu Rudy Group, Owner of Urban Escape Arena
bio: Ferry Siswadi, SE, is Director of Bu Rudy Group and owner of Urban Escape Arena in Surabaya. The son of culinary entrepreneur Bu Rudy, he developed Urban Escape as a covered padel and sports venue intended to function as a community destination.

name: Rizky Wihardi
bio: Speaker at IdeaFest SUB 2026, CEO and Managing Partner of wiseco.id.

name: Jiewa Vieri
role: Founder of INIJIE Food & Travel, INIJIE Academy
bio: Jiewa Vieri is the founder of INIJIE Food & Travel and INIJIE Academy, with 17 years of experience in social media and entrepreneurship. A food reviewer, blogger and photographer, he won the 2009 Pesta Blogger Award and continues to work in influencer marketing and photography services.

name: Cinfung
role: Entrepreneur dan Content Creator, Founder dari The Overtee, The Overtee Kids, Doesoen Roti, dan Kwakkie
bio: Stefani Angelia, known as Cinfung, is an entrepreneur and content creator who founded The Overtee, The Overtee Kids, Doesoen Roti and Kwakkie. A mother of three, she is recognized for combining family-centered storytelling and personal branding with consumer-brand building.

name: Valen Amijo
bio: Speaker at IdeaFest SUB 2026, Co-Founder of GIN.

name: Abraham Setiawan
bio: Abraham Setiawan is CEO of Bie Hin Tailor and carries forward the Surabaya tailoring house's multigenerational craft legacy. He joined the business in 2012 and has led its modernization while maintaining its custom-suit focus.

name: Andrew Wijaya
bio: Andrew Wijaya is a fourth-generation successor and Director of Sumberyala Group. He oversees three group companies spanning seafood processing, vannamei shrimp operations and related aquaculture businesses.

name: Perry Angglishartono
bio: Perry Angglishartono is Product Group Manager at PT Jamu Iboe Jaya, where he has helped position traditional jamu for contemporary consumers. He has represented the company in efforts such as the Jamu Iboe Herbal Bar and product initiatives that combine spices, vegetables and fruit.

name: Nareswari Lila
bio: Nareswari Lila is a Surabaya media personality, MC, host, moderator and content creator. With more than 14 years in media, she is also known as a morning radio announcer at Gen 103.1 FM Surabaya.

name: Nathan Santoso
bio: Nathan Santoso is the CEO of IWAK ARUMERY, a Surabaya-based arak brand, and founder of Punggawa Budaya Nusantara. He is a prominent advocate for understanding arak as a culturally significant Indonesian spirit rather than merely a party drink.

name: Alamanda
bio: Alamanda is a Surabaya multidisciplinary cultural worker and artworker at artchemist.id, working across visual art, exhibitions, radio and independent art media. She also develops cultural programs, collaborates with artists and institutions, and contributes as a discussion moderator and community-based creative educator.

name: Karin Binanto
role: CEO of Karbs, Kkado & WKM Concepts
bio: Karin Binanto is CEO of Karbs, Kkado and WKM Concepts, and a creative curator working across hospitality, lifestyle and food. She is behind brands including KKado Chicken, Karbs Bakery, Binh Binh Viet and Yong Luck, several of which were launched during the pandemic.

name: Felicia Arista
bio: Speaker at IdeaFest SUB 2026, Head of Brand Development and Strategist.

name: Deby P. Dewi
role: Managing Director of Orasis Art Space
bio: Deby P. Dewi is Managing Director of Orasis Art Space in Surabaya and an art professional whose practice began with the founding of Color Art Studio in 1998. She leads Orasis initiatives including Surabaya Art and advocates for art spaces as places for learning, dialogue and cultural participation.

name: Singgih S Kartono
role: Founder of Magno, Spedagi Bamboo Bike, Spedagi Movement, Pasar Papringan
bio: Singgih Susilo Kartono is an Indonesian product designer and the founder of Magno, the wooden-radio brand he launched in 2004, as well as the Spedagi bamboo-bike initiative. A graduate of ITB’s Product Design program, he has received international recognition including the 2008 Japan Good Design Award and 2009 Brit Insurance Design Award, and has used Pasar Papringan to advance village revitalization.

name: Rina Andriani, S.Sos., MM.
role: Lurah Nusukan, Kecamatan Banjarsari, Kota Surakarta
bio: Rina Andriani, S.Sos., M.M. is the Lurah of Nusukan in Surakarta’s Banjarsari district. An Universitas Sebelas Maret graduate, she previously drew local attention as one of Solo’s youngest village heads when she was appointed Lurah of Keprabon in 2022.

name: Steven Johnsons Tjan, BBus
bio: Steven Johnsons Tjan is an F&B entrepreneur and executive associated with Petarung Group. Public profiles and interviews also identify him as a director and CEO of Boga Group Jatim, where he has spoken about service-led leadership in the restaurant business.

name: Ivonne Sabrina
role: Country Manager of Lifewave Indonesia, Chairwoman of Surabaya Business Forum
bio: Ivonne Sabrina is Country Manager of LifeWave Indonesia and Chairwoman of the Surabaya Business Forum. Her career spans finance and operations, including roles at Global Emerging Markets, CFO of Indonesian game developer Touchten, and General Manager of Jeunesse Indonesia, which she says she returned to profitability after five consecutive loss-making years.

name: Tjahjono Haryono
role: President Director of PT Pangan Lestari
bio: Tjahjono Haryono is President Director of PT Pangan Lestari, part of the Finna Group. He is also publicly associated with East Java’s Indonesian Café and Restaurant Entrepreneurs Association (Apkrindo), connecting his leadership to the region’s food and hospitality sector.

name: Ferry Setiawan
bio: Ferry Setiawan is the chair of Apkrindo DPD Jawa Timur, the East Java chapter of Indonesia’s café and restaurant entrepreneurs association. Elected for the 2023–2027 term, he has publicly focused on enlarging the regional culinary-industry ecosystem and is also associated with Mantra Group.

name: Steven Lee Njatawidjaja, B.S., M.B.A.
role: CEO of ArtGrass and Midorie Indonesia
bio: Steven Lee Njatawidjaja is the founder and CEO of ArtGrass, established in 2013, and CEO of Midorie Indonesia. He is a business creator with a public presence across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, where he shares entrepreneurial and operational content.

name: Maria Sumargo
bio: Maria Septiani Sumargo is Director of GBT Laras Imbang, the Surabaya-based wheel-alignment and balancing specialist operated by PT Dinamis Selaras Abadi. She represents the third generation of the Sumargo family business and has appeared as a speaker in automotive-management programming in Surabaya.

name: Nysa Pratiwi
bio: Nysa Pratiwi, also known as Annisa Pratiwi, is CMO of Ladang Lima, the Indonesian food brand behind gluten-free cassava-based flour and snacks. As a mompreneur and brand leader, she has helped build Ladang Lima’s public identity around turning cassava into accessible healthier food products.

name: Monica Liando
bio: Monica Liando is CMO of Pura The Purest and a senior brand strategist at PURA Indonesia. She leads marketing for a natural-FMCG brand known for sea salt, Himalayan salt, seasonings, spices, and other natural food products.

name: Ibro Kumar
bio: Ibro Kumar, whose public profile identifies him as Risdian Kumar, is a Surabaya-based technology reviewer and content creator. Through YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok, he makes practical reviews of gadgets, apps, electric vehicles, and consumer technology.

name: Devietha Kurnia
bio: Devietha Kurnia is the founder of Yogamate, a Surabaya-based yoga community. Her work centers on making movement and wellness more accessible through shared practice and modern lifestyle programming.

name: Nadia Gunawan
bio: Nadia Gunawan is an Indonesia-based children’s-book illustrator represented by The Bright Agency. Her warm digital illustration work has been commissioned by international publishers including HarperCollins, Penguin, Pan Macmillan, and Igloo Books.

name: Evan Raditya Pratomo
role: Design Lecturer & Creative Practitioner of PAPERCAPTAIN
bio: Evan Raditya Pratomo, known as PAPERCAPTAIN, is a design lecturer and contemporary illustration designer. He is founder and visual artist of Papercaptain Studio and has presented illustration, creative-direction, and visual-art projects through his portfolio and artist channels.

name: Budi Haryono
bio: Budi Haryono is the founder of Crunchaus Salads, a healthy-food business he established in 2017. Built from his interest in healthier eating, Crunchaus has become known for making fresh, crunchy salad bowls more accessible to urban diners.

name: Andrew Wirawan
role: Owner of Cardea Surabaya and Expat. Roasters Surabaya
bio: Andrew Wirawan owns Cardea Surabaya and Expat. Roasters Surabaya. Alongside his Head of Strategy role at Bernofarm Pharmaceutical, he operates a Pilates and physiotherapy space focused on movement and healing and a specialty-coffee venture that emphasizes community.

name: Yohana Belinda
bio: Yohana Belinda is a bilingual Indonesia-based journalist and storyteller. Her reporting spans human rights, politics, fashion, and art, and has appeared in outlets including The Jakarta Post, VICE Asia, Monocle, Nikkei Asia, Rest of World, and The Japan Times.

name: Meiske D. Wahyu
role: ICF-Associate Certified Coach & Head of Partnership Pause & Grow
bio: Meiske D. Wahyu is an ICF Associate Certified Coach and Head of Partnership at Pause & Grow, where she works on strengths-based learning partnerships. Her career has included corporate law and education, and she founded the SabangMerauke student-exchange nonprofit to promote interfaith tolerance in Indonesia.

name: M. Ali Affandi L.N.M.
bio: Muhammad Ali Affandi L.N.M. is Chairman of the Surabaya Chamber of Commerce and Industry (Kadin Surabaya). Re-elected for the 2024–2029 term, he has advocated for an innovative, sustainable local economy and is publicly active as an entrepreneur and social-empowerment advocate.

name: Stephanie Susi
bio: Stephanie Susi is the founder of I’m Not Trash, an upcycling venture that uses production waste from her husband’s warehouse as creative material. She also leads Bebocto Creative and is associated with EGM Heroes, extending her work into creative-community and sustainability initiatives.

name: Carla Sutanto
bio: Carla Sutanto is a creative entrepreneur and co-founder of Nuansa Concept, an event-styling and conceptual-design studio. As the studio’s Director and Lead Conceptor, she develops events, brands, and communities designed to go beyond surface aesthetics.

name: Chitra Astriana
bio: Chitra Astriana is co-founder of DearAstrid Psychology Service and PT Citra Balita Kirana’s BaLiTa media-franchise IP. She works on online and offline brand activation and is described by TEDxSurabaya as a driving force behind BaLiTa, while building DearAstrid into a multi-branch psychology service.

name: Steven Wijaya
bio: Steven Wijaya is Managing Director of Commercial Affairs at Polygon Group, the family-owned industrial company behind a global bicycle business. His work spans commercial leadership and strategy for the Surabaya-rooted company’s international markets.

name: Fandy Soegiarto
bio: Fandy Soegiarto is an illustrator and General Manager of Caravan Studio, with more than 15 years of experience in the creative industry. His studio work includes serving as production manager for The Art of JUMBO, an official Caravan Studio publication tied to the Indonesian animated film JUMBO.

name: Agustian Pratama
role: Podcaster and Founder of Podcast Mendoan
bio: Agustian Pratama is a podcaster and co-founder of Podcast Mendoan alongside Dono Pradana. He is a Surabaya-based digital creator whose show has built a substantial YouTube audience through hundreds of podcast episodes and videos.
